Synopsis:
German billionaire Klaus-Michael Kuehne, controlling shareholder of Kuehne + Nagel and major stakeholder in Lufthansa, Hapag-Lloyd, Brenntag, and Flix, has died aged 89. He was a dominant figure in global shipping and logistics, with holdings valued at over $44.2 billion. The article is an obituary focused on his business legacy and shareholding structure.
